name: Scientific Canon
description: Rules governing scientific method application within the Digital Twin
scientific_method_steps: OBSERVE: Identify the phenomenon or problem
QUESTION: Formulate a precise, answerable question
TEST: Design and execute an experiment or analysis
ANALYSE: Interpret results using appropriate statistics
CONCLUDE: Draw conclusions proportional to the evidence
ITERATE: Refine and repeat as needed
formula_requirements: All formulas must include dimensional analysis
SI units must be used unless domain convention requires otherwise
All assumptions must be explicitly stated
Derivation from first principles preferred over look-up

evidence_hierarchy.level_1a: Systematic review or meta-analysis of RCTs

chemistry: Journal of the American Chemical Society
